mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.username as user_name, m.username as merchant_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user m ON o.merchant_id = m.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT o.*, u.username as user_name, m.username as merchant_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user m ON o.merchant_id = m.id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT o.*, u.username as user_name, m.username as merchant_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user m ON o.merchant_id = m.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, u.username as user_name, m.username as merchant_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user m ON o.merchant_id = m.id WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, merchant_id, total_amount, status, address, receiver_name, receiver_phone, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{address}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET logistics_no = #{logisticsNo}, logistics_company = #{logisticsCompany}, ship_time = NOW(), status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(pay_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amt FROM `order` WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(pay_time) ORDER BY d
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = 1, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE `order` SET status = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE `order` SET status = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status < 3
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM `order` WHERE status = 0 AND create_time < #{deadline}
